name: tuned
based_on: the default config's Febrl-style setup with match types chosen from Zingg's match-type reference: TEXT for the space-joined email list (word overlap), EXACT plus NULL_OR_BLANK for single-valued ids, company and city (Zingg treats nulls as matches unless NULL_OR_BLANK is added), FUZZY for the name parts and the full name; a larger labelling budget in the same findTrainingData and label loop
tuning: Match types and the labelling budget were chosen by looking only at the held-out world (seed 20261118); the oracle labels only held-out pairs. Zingg Community has no threshold to tune
proposed_note: none: Zingg Community exposes no match threshold and no review band

companies.based_on: These company mappings are ours: the tool's documentation has no company example, so each person field is mapped to the company field that plays the same part. This section keeps the people tuned config's match-type choices on company fields: FUZZY for the name, TEXT for the space-joined contact list, EXACT plus NULL_OR_BLANK for single-valued fields, and the same labelling budget
changes_from_doc: ours: the name parts and full name become one name field, FUZZY
ours: emails become domains, TEXT plus NULL_OR_BLANK
ours: linkedin, industry, city and country are EXACT plus NULL_OR_BLANK; the person's company and github have no company counterpart and are dropped
companies.tuning: Match types and the labelling budget are chosen on the held-out world (seed 20261118) only; the oracle labels only held-out pairs. Zingg Community has no threshold to tune
